## Summary

What does this PR change, and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Feature (`feat`)
- [ ] Bug fix (`fix`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs`)
- [ ] Refactor, tooling or CI (`refactor`, `chore`, `ci`)

## How it was tested

Describe the manual or automated tests you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title and commits follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes locally.
- [ ] Every new user-visible string is in both `locales/en` and `locales/fr`.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated for new logic and bug fixes, when practical.
- [ ] Documentation (README, docs/) was updated if behaviour or setup changed.
